4.label: Notebook LLM loop
4.secNote: 2,048 tokens ÷ 588 tok/s = 3.5 s per turn, before prefill
4.multNote: per-level multiple not recoverable from the 34.3 average

4.label: The stack
4.secNote: 15% of actions at probe cost (10 ms + minimax hybrid 640 ms) and 85% at amortized A* cost (30 ms) = 123 ms
4.pliesNote: full horizon from A* for 85% of actions; minimax depth 10 during the probing 15%
4.multNote: modeled: info-gain probes then an optimal path; the library removes the probing share on games whose mechanics were seen before, which moves the range toward 1×

4.label: Stack + mind
4.secNote: 7% of actions at probe cost (10 ms + minimax hybrid 640 ms), 93% at amortized A* cost (30 ms), plus 2 s of sleep per game amortized = 76 ms
4.pliesNote: full horizon from A* for 93% of actions; minimax depth 10 during the probing 7%
4.multNote: modeled: calibrated doubt ends probing earlier (15% to 10%) and consolidation lets about 30% of levels skip probing through a library hit

4.label: Stack + mind + offline LLM
4.secNote: stack + mind 76 ms on the CPU, plus 3 rule-synthesis calls per level × 5 s on the GPU amortized over 110 actions (136 ms) = 212 ms
4.pliesNote: full horizon from A*; the LLM writes the rule model the planner searches in
4.multNote: modeled: rule synthesis covers games the enumerator cannot express, so fewer levels stall and fewer probes are wasted

4.label: Mind only
4.secNote: 4 legal actions × 5 hypotheses × 2.0k ops per prediction at 50 M ops/s, plus about 4 ms of amortized consolidation = 4.8 ms
4.pliesNote: one predicted ply per legal action; no tree, no plan
4.multNote: modeled: calibrated predictions make learning cheap, but step-by-step progress without a horizon costs actions on levels that need a plan

4.label: Minimax αβ heuristic d8
4.multNote: modeled: depth-limited search in an uncertain model, 1.5× to 3× while the model is still being learned

4.label: Minimax αβ NNUE d11
4.multNote: modeled: same regime as the heuristic; the evaluator changes depth, not this range

4.label: Minimax αβ hybrid d10
4.multNote: modeled: same regime as the heuristic

4.label: Rule model + A*
4.secNote: assumed: one A* plan per level, about 3 s, amortized over about 100 actions
4.pliesNote: plans the full level horizon (ls20 mean baseline ≈ 110 actions per level)
4.multNote: modeled: optimal path in a correct model (≤1×) plus the actions spent learning the rules

4.label: Rule model + ASP solver
4.secNote: assumed: grounding and solving about 40 s per level, amortized over about 100 actions
4.pliesNote: plans the full level horizon with a minimality proof
4.multNote: modeled: provably minimal sequence in the model plus the learning actions

4.label: MCTS, learned prior
4.secNote: assumed: anytime budget of 0.5 s per action, thousands of rollouts
4.pliesNote: deep but sparse rollouts, about 20 plies
4.multNote: modeled: sampling finds good, not optimal, paths

4.label: Info-gain probing + A*
4.secNote: assumed: every candidate action simulated under every live hypothesis, about 10 ms, plus the amortized A* plan
4.pliesNote: full horizon once a single hypothesis remains
4.multNote: modeled: each probe chosen for information per action, then an optimal path

4.label: Mechanics library + A*
4.secNote: assumed: library match in milliseconds, short searches otherwise
4.multNote: modeled: learning cost falls on later levels and games that share mechanics; first games pay full price

4.label: CNN policy (Goose)
4.secNote: one forward pass on the GPU, about 5 ms
4.multNote: measured score 0.25: most levels never cleared, so at or beyond 5× where cleared

4.label: Human (reference)
4.secNote: estimate: about 2 s per considered move
4.multNote: the baseline is the upper median of first-time human players
